description: This script is a Perl program for creating firmware images, specifically replacing the 'brcmImagebuilder'. It reads kernel and root filesystem images, constructs headers, and outputs a combined firmware image with optional features like dual images and partitioning.

methods.name: Read_Image
methods.description: Reads entire contents of a specified file into a scalar buffer.

methods.name: Padlen
methods.description: Calculates padding length needed to align size to a specified block size.

methods.name: Pad
methods.description: Pads a buffer with 0xFF bytes to align to a block size, considering an offset.

methods.name: bcmImage
methods.description: Creates a firmware image with headers and embedded kernel and root filesystem, then writes to output file.
